# Rose City Stays

> Premium short-term and corporate rentals in Tyler, Texas. Book direct and save on fees.

Rose City Stays is a boutique short-term rental company based in Tyler, TX (the "Rose Capital of America"). We manage 10 fully furnished properties ranging from cozy 1-bedroom retreats to spacious 4-bedroom homes, all designed for guests who want a comfortable, hotel-quality stay with the space and privacy of a home.

## About

- **Location:** Tyler, Texas (Smith County), East Texas
- **Property count:** 10 properties
- **Average rating:** 4.9 stars
- **Booking channels:** Direct booking (www.rosecitystays.com), Airbnb, VRBO
- **Ideal guests:** Corporate travelers, traveling nurses, families, weekend getaways, relocation stays

## Properties

All properties are located in Tyler, TX and feature:
- High-speed WiFi (500+ Mbps)
- Self check-in (smart locks / keypad)
- Fully equipped kitchens
- Premium linens and towels
- Smart TVs
- Free parking

## Why Book Direct

Booking directly at www.rosecitystays.com (instead of Airbnb or VRBO) offers:
- Lower total cost (no OTA service fees)
- Direct communication with the host
- Flexible terms for extended stays
- Secure Stripe-powered checkout

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the minimum stay?**
Most properties require a 2-night minimum. Some properties have a 3-night minimum on weekends.

**Are pets allowed?**
Select properties are pet-friendly. Check the individual property page for pet policy.

**Is self check-in available?**
Yes. All properties use smart locks or keypad entry for 24/7 self check-in.

**Do you offer corporate or extended stay rates?**
Yes. Contact us via the Corporate Stays page for monthly rates and corporate billing options.

**Where are the properties located?**
All properties are in Tyler, TX. Neighborhoods include Hollytree, the Azalea Historic District, the Hospital District, South Tyler, and Downtown Tyler.
